blocks.content:
• India = Union of States
• States cannot secede
• Parliament can change boundaries
• Simple majority required
• Andhra Pradesh – first linguistic state
• Telangana – newest state
• 28 States and 8 UTs
• Ladakh – newest UT

Expect at least 1 question from this chapter.

items: Parliament requires only a simple majority (not a special majority) to alter state boundaries.
Andhra Pradesh is frequently asked in exams as the first linguistic state of India.
Remember the current tally: 28 States and 8 UTs (Telangana is the newest state; Ladakh is the newest UT).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: India is defined as a Union of States, and member states do not have the right to secede.
Parliament holds the authority to alter or change state boundaries through a simple majority.
Andhra Pradesh holds the distinction of being the first state formed on a linguistic basis.
The country currently comprises a total of 28 States and 8 Union Territories.
Telangana is the newest state in India, while Ladakh is recognized as the newest Union Territory.
